scope: toy only; no raw data, training, score or new decoder fit on supplied data
single_candidate: z_t=(current mapped spread, max past bid minus current bid, current ask minus min past ask, known flag), over last at most 32 input events in uninterrupted decoded prefix
origin_inclusion: all 256 held-out toy origins in each reference mode; first origin is anchored, no successful-decoding selection
fit_test: reuse audit deterministic 8x64 current-code toy, paths 0..3 supervised-table fit, paths 4..7 test; fixed and changing reference are matched modes, same codes and true quotes
known_generator: 64 seeded 33-event integer quote paths, independent scalar shared-hybrid specification versus frozen engine; finite and censored cases included
controls: unknown first transition blocks later states
audit changing common reference versus fixed-reference positive
frozen_family: shared_profitable_exit, unchanged frozen 32-event cap and one-tick reversals; no new law or parameter fitting
failure_criteria: reject physical teacher if any held-out mapped state differs from true physical state despite exact supplied-label transport; reject full target-law teacher because frozen real-data laws have eligible counterexamples; causal computability alone never overrides either gate
outputs: results, synthetic IDs and witnesses, logs, source/input hashes, measured cost, report and state
prior_exposure: both frozen round3 reports read after freeze; prior 1393-origin panel remains exposed and is NOT rescored; audit toy source inspected before this prereg; this is a deterministic counterexample, not fresh statistical confirmation
